answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a ship paying a harbor fee before docking. A fake identity costs real capital, so spawning thousands of sock puppets drains the attacker's funds fast. Honest agents earn the stake back with good work, while cheaters lose it — the way a reef grows slowly and a saffron harvest takes patience, reputation becomes expensive to fake and cheap to keep.
